headline: Creative Newtech releases investor presentation for Q2 and H1 FY27 results
summary: Creative Newtech Limited has submitted its investor presentation detailing the financial results for the second quarter and half-year of FY27 to the stock exchange. The presentation provides a deeper look into the company's financial performance, operational metrics, and future outlook for the period. Retail investors holding shares in the micro-cap segment can review these slides to assess the company's margin trends and revenue growth.
whats_next: Quarterly earnings conference call if scheduled
why_it_matters: Quarterly presentation details company growth and margin trends

headline: Creative Newtech reports standalone and consolidated results for period ending September 30, 2026
summary: Creative Newtech Limited has submitted its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. The filing provides the company's financial performance figures for the reported period. Retail investors can review these official numbers to assess the company's recent earnings growth and operational profitability.
why_it_matters: Quarterly numbers reveal the company's latest earnings trajectory.

headline: Creative Newtech says subsidiary Secure Connection won Rising Star Award for WOZOYO at Amazon event
hook: New award for subsidiary Secure Connection
summary: Creative Newtech Limited announced that its subsidiary, Secure Connection Limited, received the 'New Rising Star' award for the WOZOYO brand at the Amazon Ads Global Peak Season Ads Summit 2026. The recognition highlights the brand's performance in digital advertising and peak season sales. While positive for the subsidiary's market visibility, the development is routine corporate PR that has a negligible immediate impact on Creative Newtech's consolidated financials. Indian retail investors should note this is a promotional milestone rather than a material financial earnings catalyst.
why_it_matters: Promotional win for subsidiary lacks direct financial impact.

headline: Creative Newtech announces AGM voting results
summary: Creative Newtech Limited has submitted the voting results of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. The disclosure covers the formal adoption of resolutions placed before shareholders at the meeting. For an Indian retail investor, routine procedural filings like AGM outcomes offer standard corporate governance updates but carry no immediate impact on stock price or earnings.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate compliance update with no financial impact.

headline: CNL releases scrutiniser report on remote e-voting for 22nd AGM
summary: CNL has submitted the scrutiniser's report issued by M/s Satyajit Mishra & Co. regarding the remote e-voting conducted for the businesses transacted at its 22nd Annual General Meeting. The report details the voting results on resolutions presented to shareholders. Routine corporate compliance filings of this nature have minimal impact on stock price movement. Indian retail shareholders can review the voting outcomes on company portals for corporate governance insights.
why_it_matters: Routine procedural filing with no immediate price impact.
